title: Deepfake Lens scan JSON — result contract v2
description: Project-owned (not vendored) schema of `deepfake-lens scan --format json` from schema_version 2 (phase 0, G5/G6/G12/G24). Conclusions are one of three verdicts; evidence is classified deterministic/statistical/lexical; coverage records every check that ran, was skipped, or failed. Legacy v1 fields stay for read-compat and are derived from the v2 fields.

temp_folder.description: R15-6: where the run's temp files were made — fallback=false in the temp folder the operator/system named; fallback=true with the folder used (base), the Korean reason the named one was unusable and the variable that chooses it (override_env = DEEPFAKE_LENS_TMPDIR). R16-10: requested is the folder that could not be used and requested_by who named it (DEEPFAKE_LENS_TMPDIR, DEEPFAKE_LENS_NATIVE_TMPDIR or the system temp folder).

scan_root_b64.description: R12-4: web/API folder scans only — scan_root as URL-safe base64 of its file-system bytes (os.fsencode); the GUI sends it as root_b64 to /api/preview and /api/heatmap (a non-UTF-8 folder name cannot travel as text in a URL).

scan_root.description: Web/API folder scans only (P1): the scanned folder, absolute and resolved — every row path is relative to it. POST /api/report requires it back (scan_root) and resolves rows against it only. R9-9: in a POST /api/report signed body (and the evidence statement it renders) scan_root is that folder relative to the read root holding it ("." for the root itself) — inside the MAC and printed in the report header (검사 폴더(읽기 루트 기준, 행 경로의 기준 폴더): …); absent when no folder-scan row was posted.

analysis_options.description: R19-3 / P0R-6: POST /api/report signed bodies only — the analysis options of the server-held scan job the report signs (captured when the scan ran): pixel mode, heatmaps, deep_signals, default_engine, model_path (profile file names) and fusion_profile (a file name or null). Printed in every rendering as 재분석 옵션(…).

files_cancelled_source.description: R19-3 / P0R-6: POST /api/report signed bodies of a cancelled scan only — server: summary.files_cancelled is the count of the server-held scan job the report signs. unverified: reports made before P0R-6 only (a posted 'cancelled' without such a job).

excluded_items.description: POST /api/report signed bodies only: rows the report lists but does not sign — since P0R-6 the request's upload rows (P6, R22-8); path, marker, reason and name_source only (never the client's result). Before P0R-6 also posted rows the server could not re-analyze.

name_source.description: R22-8: upload rows only — server_upload when this server process produced an upload row of that path and sha256 (/api/analyze-upload, /api/check), client when the name is only the client's text (its reason says 클라이언트 제공 이름). Upload names are limited to 255 characters, relative, with no empty, . or .. component (400 otherwise).

scan_job.description: P0R-6: web/API folder scans only — the id of this scan as a server-held job (bound to the server's token); the only thing POST /api/report accepts for folder rows.

scan_job_note.description: P0R-6: web/API folder scans only, present when the job could not be persisted (held in memory only — a server restart loses it); Korean.

exhibit_paths.description: P0R-6: POST /api/report signed bodies only, when the request chose exhibits — the ordered row paths of the job the evidence statement numbers as exhibits; every row of the job is in items either way.

tool_version.description: Signed reports only (G30): tool version, inside the MAC.

model_pins.description: Signed reports only (G30): runtime-profile pins, inside the MAC; pin null = unpinned.

signature_note.description: Inside the MAC; says 서명 없음 when unsigned.

signature_key_id.description: Outside the MAC; mismatch is reported as 키 ID 불일치.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over every field except signature and signature_key_id.

unrecorded_files.description: X1: files of the scanned folder without an analysis result, by reason (also in the HTML/PDF report bodies, the evidence statement and the legal report). subfolders counts folders; every other reason counts files (P5: subfolder_files = files inside those folders, archive_rejected = refused archive members, failed = rows that failed without a result).

code.description: R22-1: not_in_report appears only in web reports (with listing).

archive_rejected_by_category.description: P5: refused archive members per Korean category (압축 폭탄·예산 초과, 경로 이탈, 링크·특수 파일, 중첩 깊이 초과, 기타).

lines.description: Korean headline followed by one line per non-zero reason.

listing.description: R22-1: web reports (POST /api/report) only — where the counts come from. scan_job: the server's own finished scan job of the same folder; walk: reports made before P0R-6 only (the server's own walk of the scan folder); since P0R-6 a report with a scan job is always scan_job (every job row is signed, not_in_report 0); unknown: the server could not list the folder (no scan folder, a walk limit, an unreadable folder, or a signed row outside its listing) — the headline says 확인 불가 with reason and no cap/subfolder count is signed. not_in_report: files of the listing without a signed row (also the reasons entry not_in_report); R23-5: and archive members the server's re-analysis of a signed container yields without a signed row (with a scan_job listing: members that job analyzed).

subfolder_detail.description: P5: one entry per subfolder a flat scan did not enter: regular files below it (recursive, symlinks neither followed nor counted); complete=false when the count stopped at a walk limit. R10-8: already_counted_folders (present only when > 0) is the number of folders below it skipped because they were already counted under another entry (a folder link into an earlier one) — its files are not in this entry's files.

container_rows.description: Archive container rows among the verdict rows (already in the verdict counts, R5/N5).

subfolders_skipped.description: Subfolders of the scan root a non-recursive scan did not enter (0 when recursive) — never omitted silently (N8).

files_over_cap.description: Files the walk found beyond the --max-files cap — never analyzed, no row (X1); 0 when not capped.

subfolder_files_skipped.description: P5: regular files inside the subfolders a non-recursive scan did not enter (recursive count, symlinks excluded).

cancelled.description: R18-3: the scan was cancelled before every file was analyzed — a partial result.

files_cancelled.description: R18-3: files (archive members included) a cancel left unanalyzed — no row; the unrecorded_files reason cancelled.

summary.description: Verdict counts only (D16): the legacy band counts high/medium/low/unknown are not serialized.

path.description: Row path relative to the scan root; archive members as "archive::inner", nested archive members as the full chain "a.zip::b.zip::c.png" (Y9; never ".unpacked/") (N11: /api/report refuses a row that does not fit this item contract).

path_b64.description: R12-4: every row except archive members — the row's real relative path (path with the R9-1 escape undone) as URL-safe base64 of its file-system bytes (os.fsencode, a non-UTF-8 name's original bytes). GET /api/preview?path_b64=…&root_b64=<scan_root_b64> (and /api/heatmap with pixel_analysis.heatmap_path_b64) name the file by it, under the same read-root checks; a malformed value is 400.

name.description: The file name as it is on disk (raw: a bidi override, C1 control or lone surrogate — written as the JSON escape \udcXX, R11-1 — stays as it is).

display_name.description: R11-14: name as every text report shows it (result_text.display_name — controls and invisible characters escaped, "|" as "\|", "\" as "\\"); for consumers that print the name. Emitted on every row since R11-14; absent on older records.

container.description: P7: archive member rows only — the container row's path (path = container + "::" + member); absent on every other row.

member.description: P7: archive member rows only — the member path inside the container (a nested chain joined by "::"). R9-1: a row's identity is container/member only, never a "::" in path. A real file's row path holding "::" or "\:" is escaped per character (every "\" as "\\", every ":" as "\:"), so it never contains "::" and unescapes exactly. R26-1: each segment of the chain (an archive level's path) that holds "::" or "\" or starts or ends with ":" is escaped the same way, so a literal member "inner.zip::b.png" is "inner.zip\:\:b.png" and never the chain of b.png inside the nested inner.zip; an unescaped "::" always separates segments.

member_index.description: R12-3: archive member rows only — the member's 1-based position among its container's extracted members (archive order; a nested archive's members follow it). (container, member, member_index) is unique; two entries with the same name no longer overwrite each other — the later one's member is "<path>#2" (#3 …) and its limitations start with the "중복 멤버 이름" reason. Absent on every other row.

source.description: P6: rows of /api/analyze-upload and /api/check (uploaded or pasted, never a file of a read root) — POST /api/report lists them under excluded_items and never re-analyzes or signs them.

result.description: null for a row without analysis (skipped, unsupported, failed, duplicate); draft 2020-12 applies a sibling $ref, so null must be its own anyOf branch (N3).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the analyzed file bytes (G11/G30); null when not hashed.

probability.description: Set only from a calibrated statistical item.

marking_context.description: techniques-2026 item 6: the machine-readable marks checked for this file (EU AI Act Art. 50 / 인공지능기본법 context) — facts only, never a conclusion; the absence of a mark is not evidence of originality. Null for rows not analyzed as media/documents.

raw_score.description: Uncalibrated model/heuristic output (0-100); never a probability.

reason.description: Required (non-empty) for skipped/failed; failed starts with the exception class name.
